calendar.name: Google Calendar
gmail.name: Gmail
calendar.scopeNote: Connect your own Google account. Demos, meetings and holds created here appear in your calendar, and calendar events that involve a known contact appear here. Other events on your calendar are never copied.
gmail.gateTitle: Gmail is limited while Google reviews our app
gmail.gateBody: Gmail uses a restricted Google permission. Until Google finishes its security review, Gmail works only for people the platform owner has added as named test users (at most 100).
gmail.reason.app_mode_unknown: The platform has not said whether the Google app is in testing, so Gmail stays closed.
gmail.reason.app_in_production_unverifie: The Google app is published but has not passed the security review, so Gmail stays closed.
gmail.reason.not_opted_in: Your organisation has not opted in to Gmail yet.
gmail.optIn.restricted: I understand Gmail asks for a restricted permission and that only threads with people already in this workspace are read.
gmail.optIn.testUser: My Google account has been added as a test user by the platform owner.
gmail.testing: Testing mode: limited to named test users.
gmail.scopeNote: Only mail to or from people already in this workspace is read. Everything else in your mailbox is never stored. Replies are sent from your own Gmail.
gmail.send.noContact: You can only reply to people already in this workspace.
